newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi index rises on higher activity.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi index rises on higher activity.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Monday as share prices gained marginally in good volumes, brokers said.
The index rose 10.99 points to stand at 3058.54. Turnover was posted at 8.426 million shillings on 262,881 shares from 5.562 million shillings on 263,043 shares on Friday.
A senior broker said the market was slightly up on higher activity compared to last week where trading was sluggish.
"Investors have started to come back into the market. They want to liven it up," the broker said.
"This sale of 11.88 million primary shares for Kenya Commercial Bank had driven most of the investors out of the market (into chasing the issue)," he added.
An official said most counters traded. Heavy interest was in National Bank of Kenya and National Industrial Credit where very many small lots were dealt.

National Bank of Kenya traded 89,900 shares at 16 shillings from 16.05, National Industrial Credit dealt 29,000 shares at 41, Barclays Bank rose 2.0 to 102 while Kenya Commerical Bank was unchanged at 52.50.
Brokers said Unga Group Ltd which announced its final divident of 9.00 and a bonus issue of one share for every three shares. The stock surged 7.0 shillings to 161.
Car & General eased to 20 from 20.50, Lonrho Motors rose a shilling to 120 and Kenya Airways fell to 10.15 from 10.25 on 16,303.

A broker said that he could not give a definite reason for the sea-saw trend in Kenya Airways. Kenya Airways traded very thin volumes; At 16,303 shares, it was the lowest number of shares dealt in the airline since the stock was first traded on the exchange on June 3.
Officials said foreign investors traded 21,000 shares of at 41 and 42, 10,000 shares of Kenya Power & Lighting at 107 and 18,000 shares of Kenya Breweries at 45 and 48 shillings.
